game_concept: A card battler set in Eldritch Ruins – Weathered Gate, a weathered stone gate: the ruin warden must handle eldritch shades while practicing lists. Core idea – Mutation Mystery: Spot when two names point to the same list and when copy() is needed.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Weathered Gate: a weathered stone gate
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
player_objective: Declare char: declare resource as char, apply resource + 70, and print each result with %c. Dataset 5 starts with [0, 1, 2, 3]. Match every stream. Use a full main function and a return statement.
controls: Edit the C program. Run tests all streams; Step shows declarations, assignments and output. readInput() is a LogiCade game-port helper declared in logicade.h. This safe practice runtime supports a documented C subset.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Mutation Mystery' (Week 7 slot 15), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Weathered Gate'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Basic Parts of C and Variable Declarations

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.
Build the circuit or route, or edit the node/adventure program.
Use Step to inspect state; Run checks the real outputs and goals.
Revise errors before using the remaining execution checks.
source_player_objective: Chain 11 consecutive correct decisions about mutation_safe to power up the ruin warden and open the relic vault.
source_lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
hint: Declare before use. char resource = readInput(); creates the named game-port value; printf uses %c.
